# Scaffold Vue.js App

Scaffold a production-ready Vue 3 application with TypeScript, Vite, Composition API, `<script setup lang="ts">`, Vue Router, and Pinia where required. Before scaffolding, collect the project name and verify a new empty destination outside the Orchestrator-Agent repository. Never overwrite an existing app.

Classify the input and follow source analysis, Atomic Design or Design Analysis, UI Layout Generation, Functional Development, Accessibility Validation, Test Case Generation, automated unit/integration tests, and cross-browser/responsive testing. Reuse compatible tooling; use Vitest with Vue Test Utils when no unit runner exists and Playwright for browser journeys. Apply WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 by default, targeting WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

Do not leave the default starter page, dead routes, or fake controls. Implement the selected domain's routes, typed data, working interactions, accessible responsive shell, loading/empty/error states, and validation. Run focused tests, lint, typecheck, build, and browser checks before reporting completion.
